instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Close decisions that will never be carried on, and keep why", and give it decisions; by.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:end-a-decision and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Sets each named decision's status to ended and keeps the status it had (previous_status), ended_at, ended_by and ended_because, with every other field unchanged and nothing deleted.
